name: propzone_intel_eval
description: 25 binary assertions for PropZone Intel agent — API scraper, gap analysis, Supabase storage

assertions.desc: fetchPublicToken() calls propzone.gridics.com/graphql with mainSettings query
fetchPublicToken() returns non-empty publicToken string
fetchPublicToken() returns mapboxToken from GraphQL response
fetchPlaces() hits pr1-api.gridics.com/api/ui-api with type=_place
fetchPlaces() returns array of PlaceRecord with id and title fields
resolvePlaceId() matches 'satellite-beach' to correct Gridics place ID
resolvePlaceId() throws descriptive error when city not found
fetchPropertyPage() includes all 35 PROPERTY_FIELDS in request
fetchPropertyPage() returns rows array and total count
fetchAllProperties() paginates using PAGE_SIZE=100 until total exhausted
fetchAllProperties() stops when empty rows returned (no infinite loop)
upsertToSupabase() maps parcel_id, zone_code, max_height, setbacks correctly
upsertToSupabase() POSTs to /rest/v1/propzone_intel with merge-duplicates Prefer header
upsertToSupabase() batches records in groups of 500
upsertToSupabase() returns count of stored records
upsertToSupabase() warns gracefully when SUPABASE_URL/KEY not set
setbacks stored as JSONB with front/side/rear/water keys
scrape command saves JSON backup to propzone-output/<city>-<timestamp>.json
compare command fetches both propzone_intel and zoning_assignments for parcel
analyzeGaps() identifies fields present in PropZone but missing in ZoneWise
fetchWithRetry() retries up to MAX_RETRIES=3 on HTTP failure
fetchWithRetry() uses exponential backoff between retries
sendTelegram() sends gap count notification when TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN is set
--help prints all 4 commands (scrape, compare, fields, test)
cmdTest() validates all 3 API layers: GraphQL, places, property records
